Figure 2: Overview of WSCOD with bounding-box supervision (BoxSAM). By annotating the bounding-boxes of the camouflaged objects and combining the SAM [25] model to output the pseudo-labels, we design a redundancy processing strategy (see Section 3.2) with MGNet (see Section 3.3) to process the pseudo-labels.

Figure 3: Bounding-box annotations method, images from CAMO [26] and COD10K [8]. The green bounding-boxes represent our annotated bounding-boxes. The annotations are classified into 3 cases: (a) A bounding-box contains a camouflaged object. (b) Multiple bounding-boxes contain multiple camouflaged objects. (c) A bounding-box contains multiple camouflaged objects.
